benchmarks.note: ascending ramp 1..=n (elbow at the midpoint). A single O(n) running-sum scan over the ordered importance values: each candidate split is an O(1) incremental update of the two-group sufficient statistics. Runtime is strictly linear in the input length (the 10000 point is ~10x the 1000 point)

two-block step (first half high, second half low — a sharp gap). Same O(n) single-pass cost as the ramp regardless of where the elbow lands; the scan always visits every split point, so the data shape does not change the asymptotics
